system.summary: Mixed nomenclator: two-digit groups for letters with 2-3 homophones, two-lower-case-letter codes for words, three-digit groups as nulls, 90 alone = und; doubled letters written once.

prior_solution.where: Interlinear, marginal or facing-page decipherments of the time on every enciphered passage seen (Stuttgart chancery). No edition or study of the cipher found: Obser (PC Karl Friedrichs, vol. 3) cites Abel in passing; nothing in this repository on main (catalogue, leads, targets; 12 Nov 2026).

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout set the rules (protocols hashed before calculation, one held-out measurement per key, thresholds fixed in advance). AI agents transcribed, aligned, built K2/K3, measured and read. No human palaeographer checked the transcription.
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout

solution.what: Glossed passages of Bue 696 (Bild 7-9, 29-31, 44, 50) and Bue 702 (Bild 16-19) transcribed token by token.
Cipher lines lined up with the interlinear glosses; K1/K2 built by majority letter per code from Bue 696.
Held-out Bue 696 Bild 44, 50, 29: characters 0.895, words 0.621 (word criterion 0.75 missed); K2 on Bue 702 Bild 16: 0.863 / 0.367, not validated (1799 homophones missing).
K3 = K2 + Bue 702 Bild 16, frozen before Bild 17; held out Bild 17 (24 words): 0.963 characters / 0.792 words against 0.306 / 0.167 for 200 permuted keys.
Unglossed passages of Bue 699 Bild 75, 86, 90 read with K3: 24 words, 14 sure, 6 probable, 4 unresolved (83 %).
Bue 696 Bild 50: the later pencil gloss Georgi is wrong, the key reads albert (clear paragraph about Albert).

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: K3 was learnt from the contemporary interlinear glosses of the same file and validated once on a held-out piece; the passages without a gloss were read with it.

validation.notes: K3: 0.963 / 0.792 against 0.306 / 0.167 (200 permuted keys), thresholds 0.85 / 0.75 fixed beforehand; earlier keys failed the word criterion and are reported.

outcome.fraction_read_source: reading.md: 24 words of the unglossed passages, strict count 14 sure (0.583); with 6 probable 20 (0.833); the glossed passages are read from their decipherments of the time.
